# Monday 19/10/2026

Cellpose finished but the resolution of the image generated is bad. Now I want to submit a job to test how well it went, with SpaceRanger and the masks. They're in .npy format, now I have to check if it is a valid input format for SR. 

````{bash}
sbatch -o log_TMA_3_4_cellpose.txt -e error_TMA_3_4_cellpose.txt -J TMA_3_4_cellpose -c 2 --mem=50G -t1440 --wrap="/storage/scratch01/users/lsantos/SpaceRanger_TMA/spaceranger-4.1.0/spaceranger count --id=TMA_3_4_cellpose --transcriptome=/storage/scratch01/users/lsantos/SpaceRanger_TMA/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2024-A --fastqs=/storage/scratch01/groups/ce/BLCA_Spatial/TMA_3_4/fastq_3_4 --probe-set=/storage/scratch01/users/lsantos/SpaceRanger_TMA/Visium_Human_Transcriptome_Probe_Set_v2.1.0_GRCh38-2024-A.csv --cytaimage=/storage/scratch01/groups/ce/BLCA_Spatial/TMA_3_4/cytassist_image.tiff --image=/storage/scratch01/groups/ce/BLCA_Spatial/TMA_3_4/AL-7332_99B-15848-3D_3_97-47941S_4_clean_crop.tif --loupe-alignment=/storage/scratch01/groups/ce/BLCA_Spatial/TMA_3_4/H1-C692N9D-D1-fiducials-crop-image-registration.json --create-bam=false --custom-segmentation-file=/storage/scratch01/groups/ce/BLCA_Spatial/CELLPOSE/cellpose_outsmasks_cellpose.npy  --nucleus-expansion-distance-micron=8"
````

# Tuesday 20/10/2026

I'm going to download smurf-full, in the cellpose conda environment because there I know the gpu is working well. Once, it finished I run again smurf in cellpose environment. 

I also fixed the github of the ExternalPractices, adding the workflows of the tools implemented. https://github.com/luciasantosm/ExternalPractices 

Finally, I submitted a SR job with the .npy masks generated by cellpose

# Wednesday 21/10/2026

Both jobs, SR cellpose and smurf could't be saved due to a limit reached in the number of files of the project. So, I cleaned the folders and rerun the jobs. 

Also, I'm trying the StarDist in QuPath with the samples 7_8, using the parameters th=0.3 and pixelsize=0.5 --> 9 min [aprox. 109.000]
Then, as I saw that maybe the nuclei detected were few, I runned it again but with a lower th, th=0.25--> 9 min [aprox. 125.000]

I shared also, the drive folder with crop images and the metadata of the samples
